English: Scholars' Refuge
A quiet refuge where curious minds gather and the first formal exchange of ideas takes shape.
Scriptorium Hall
A permanent chamber for copying texts and collecting knowledge in primitive but durable forms.
Foundation College
A basic educational institution emerges, offering limited instruction in administration and thought.
Civic Academy
A growing center where civic and scholarly disciplines begin to be codified and taught methodically.
Regional Lyceum
Educators and students from surrounding lands gather, fostering a burgeoning regional influence.
Chancellery of Thought
An established institution where abstract theory, law, and statecraft are all subject to vigorous study.
Grand Collegium
A vast campus of interlinked disciplines, fostering debate, archives, and advancement across fields.
Imperial University
An elite establishment with state backing, where military, cultural, and economic knowledge is centralized.
Seat of Enlightenment
The university now shapes governance, faith, and innovation across realms, drawing foreign dignitaries.
Panarchic Institute
A beacon of wisdom whose influence reaches beyond borders, guiding both kings and councils.
